form.label: Dell PowerScale OneFS audit - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage dashboard for Dell PowerScale OneFS protocol and configuration audit smoke events. This is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=infraops sourcetype IN ("dell:powerscale:onefs:protocol","dell:powerscale:onefs:config") host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="dell:powerscale:onefs:config" host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") | stats count

index=infraops sourcetype IN ("dell:powerscale:onefs:protocol","dell:powerscale:onefs:config") host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") eventType IN (rename,modify) | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype IN ("dell:powerscale:onefs:protocol","dell:powerscale:onefs:config") host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") | timechart count by sourcetype

index=infraops sourcetype IN ("dell:powerscale:onefs:protocol","dell:powerscale:onefs:config") host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") | stats count by eventType, detailType | sort -count | head 20

index=infraops sourcetype="dell:powerscale:onefs:protocol" host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") | table _time host source protocol zoneName eventType detailType clientIPAddr src userID userSID user fileName newFileName marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype="dell:powerscale:onefs:config" host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") | table _time host source topic eventType detailType actor object action signature marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype IN ("dell:powerscale:onefs:protocol","dell:powerscale:onefs:config") host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") | stats count, values(eventType) as actions, values(detailType) as detail_types, values(fileName) as files, values(newFileName) as new_files by clientIPAddr, userID, userSID, actor | sort -count | head 50

index=infraops sourcetype IN ("dell:powerscale:onefs:protocol","dell:powerscale:onefs:config") host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") | stats count, dc(marker) as markers, values(vendor_product) as vendor_product, values(eventType) as actions by host, source, sourcetype | sort -count | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype IN ("dell:powerscale:onefs:protocol","dell:powerscale:onefs:config") host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") marker="SC4S_DELL_POWERSCALE_TEST_*" | table _time host sourcetype marker eventType detailType protocol topic clientIPAddr userID actor object | sort marker

index=infraops sourcetype IN ("dell:powerscale:onefs:protocol","dell:powerscale:onefs:config") host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype="$family_tok$" OR "$family_tok$"="*") | table _time host source sourcetype eventType detailType marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
